Chabad Roma

Campus-Chabad-House · Roma, Italy

Chabad centre

Previous review (2026-10-06): No complete current street address verified; contact institution before creating a map location. Research 2026-10-13: Headquarters gives Rome only. The 5786 community calendar lists central-office contacts without an address (p. 21) and Chabad teaching at Balbo 33 (p. 17). The Israeli Chabad directory lists Via Ottavio Panciroli 7 for Chabad-Lubavitch of Rome. These may represent different premises. Balbo 33 is also the Bet Hatalmud address, so the generic centre must be reconciled before adding another location.
